_scenario_name: Atlas Corp — US Delaware-C parent, India engineering team
_narrative: Atlas Corp is Delaware-incorporated, Series B. 60 % of engineering is based in Bengaluru via the Indian subsidiary Atlas Tech India Pvt Ltd. A senior engineer was granted 25,000 NSOs at $0.50 strike during her Indian employment. FMV at exercise is $4.00 — she exercises 8,000 options on 30 April 2026. The Schwab-pipeline case: Atlas's CFO needs to know what the Indian engineer owes and what the parent files, before authorising the exercise.
